blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Typhoon Cempaka entered the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR) on Monday morning and was given the local name Samuel, the state weather bureau said. READ: Amihan to bring cooler weather to much of Luzon on Nov. 9 According to the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa), Samuel was last spotted 1,370 kilometers east-northeast of Extreme Northern Luzon. The typhoon had maximum sustained winds of 120 kilometers per hour (kph) near its center and gusts of up to 150 kph.
